name.ja: BB戦士327 曹丕ガンダム

description.ja: 「ＢＢ戦士３２７ 曹丕ガンダム」が登場！
description.en: "BB Senshi 327 Cao Pi Gundam" is now available!

description.ja: ●武器や鎧などの宝石をクリアパーツで贅沢に再現
description.en: - Luxurious reproduction of weapons, armor, and other jewels with clear parts

description.ja: ●自身の武器に加え、二本の宝剣が付属、鎧と合体して必殺技「蒼炎転舞」を再現
description.en: -In addition to your own weapon, two treasure swords are included, and combine with the armor to reproduce the special move "Blue Flame Tenbu"

description.ja: ●兜と胸の飾り、二本の宝剣は、曹操ガンダム（別売）にパワーアップパーツとして取り付け可能
description.en: -The helmet, chest decoration, and two treasured swords can be attached to Cao Cao Gundam (sold separately) as power-up parts.
